biography.background: From Fort Worth/Midland. Grew up in oil family (French Oil Company, Midland). Energy trader for a decade after 1994. Ran security businesses in Middle East for major energy companies. Tarrant County Republican Party Chairman (2023-2025), resigned to run for Railroad Commission. Earlier career: aide under Republican TX Land Commissioner Jerry Patterson; Legislative Director for Democratic U.S. Rep. Pete Gallego.

primaryResult: Finished first in March 3, 2026 Republican primary with 33.3%, forcing runoff against incumbent James Wright (31.5%). Runoff May 26, 2026.

policyPositions.position: Decentralize permit approval back to regional RRC offices; modernize to electronic submission
Roll back RRC environmental rules he characterizes as 'Biden-era EPA regulations'; reduce regulatory burden on oil and gas
End DEI-based RRC contracting (claims ~$1M/year); enforce competitive bidding on all contracts
Block Chinese land and oil asset acquisition in Texas
Proposes formal joint research/cooperation agreement between TX RRC and Israeli energy industry
Reform plugging process for efficiency and cost reduction (framed as fiscal, not environmental)
